answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a model, named CPCC, to capture role preference, dialogue coherence, and translation consistency with latent variables learned by the CVAE for neural chat translation.

answer_2.quote: We use the Sacre-BLEU and v0.7.25 for TER (the lower the better) ... We also use cosine similarity to measure dialogue coherence.

answer_4.quote: We assign each bilingual dialogue history and corresponding 6 generated translations to three human annotators ... evaluate whether each translation meets the criteria defined above.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluate translations according to four criteria: Preference, Coherence, Consistency, Fluency.
